explanation: Searched Mathlib for `posSimplexFin`, `volume_posSimplex`, and simplex-volume results. Mathlib has general affine-simplex volume results in `Mathlib/Geometry/Euclidean/Volume/MeasureSimplex.lean`, but applying them here would require identifying this set with a simplex interior and relating its volume, which is more than routine one- or two-line glue. The proof instead uses `volume_posSimplexFin`, a declaration from the library itself.
